messages:
tara: FYI support flagged a small set of requests that got billed to the wrong org. Looks like the edge kept an older `X-Org` on a reused connection and telemetry counted that. Minimal repro below.

tara: repro: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer projless_01" -H "X-Request-ID: r-204" \
  -H "X-Org: theta-corp" https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
edge responds with `X-Org: zeta-inc` but auth metadata owner=zeta-inc. Console shows charge under zeta-inc while request used a key belonging to theta-corp.

vik: That matches the keep-alive header bleed we suspected after the affinity patch. The fast-path avoided auth enrichment in some code paths.

ben: Quick mitigation options: 1) Always overwrite X-Org after auth (safer, slightly higher p99 latency). 2) Auth service emits an internal header `X-Auth-Owner` signed by HMAC; edge trusts internal header and telemetry prefers it. 3) Strip client headers at ingress and rely only on token claims/lookup.

tara: I prefer 2 for perf; 1 is safest though. If we pick 2 we must prevent clients from spoofing `X-Auth-Owner` (strip incoming headers + validate HMAC). Also need a FF to control behavior.

vik: Telemetry note: switching precedence will change dash numbers for a small cohort. Add `attribution_mismatch_count` and sample N request_ids with both owners to S3 for triage. We'll need a migration flag so we can compare side-by-side.

ux: Console: when owners differ show both values in the request detail and a small badge so support can triage quickly. Link to sample logs.

ben: Plan: 
- auth: resolve owner for projectless keys and emit `X-Internal-Auth-Owner` + HMAC.
- edge: strip inbound X-Org, validate HMAC, populate `X-Telemetry-Owner` when FF enabled.
- telemetry: prefer `X-Telemetry-Owner` when present. Emit `attribution_conflicts_total` and `attribution_conflict_samples`.

tara: Rollout: FF `prefer_internal_owner` default off. Canary 5% internal for 6h -> check `attribution_conflicts_total`, quota drift, support tickets -> 30% sandbox 24h -> 100% after signoff. Rollback by toggling FF.

ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: Reserved canary window 2026-04-01 03:00-06:00 UTC. Notifying oncall.

vik: I'll take the edge change and FF. Ben takes auth header + HMAC. Tara will coordinate telemetry + console changes and write the rollout doc. UX will add the badge. QA to add smoke tests for spoofing attempts.

tara: Thanks all. I'll open the rollout doc and add the list of metrics to monitor. PR links when ready. :thumbsup:
